sources.title: GitHub - pmarreck/gemma4-heretical: Abliterated Gemma 4 31B for Ollama ...
sources.snippet: One-command setup for an uncensored (abliterated) Gemma 4 31B model in Ollama, with optional MLX support for native Apple Silicon inference. Uses the best available community abliteration: trohrbaugh/gemma-4-31b-it-heretic-ara, produced by Heretic using Arbitrary-Rank Ablation (ARA).

sources.title: google/gemma-4-31b • LM Studio
sources.snippet: Gemma is a family of open models built by Google DeepMind. Gemma 4 models are multimodal, handling text and image input (with audio supported on small models) and generating text output. Gemma 4 introduces key capability and architectural advancements: Reasoning - All models in the family are designed as highly capable reasoners, with configurable thinking modes.
